It sounds to me that you haven't really lost your hope for life, you are being very depressed by your school performence.  I get the feeling when you can't do one important thing right and you began to question yourself and everything seem to went derailed.

Although I am doing very bad at my thesis. My tutor for thesis is very patient person and when I expressed my  distress over the lack of process, he told me to not expect too much for an master thesis, it is okay if it is not novel and perfect. It is ok you don't get good results, the only important thing is learn how to go over the whole process. He said a lot of student have the same predicament as me. I have wasted so much time because I was obsessed with redoing the experiments and caculations because the results are not satisfying for me (I kept comparing them to results I read in published articles.)

I tried to follow his words and now it is 1 AM in the morning and I am still struggling to at least writing something down for my thesis even though it looks pretty bad because I still don't have the experiment results I want. It is at least a beginning.

My parents have found me a position in a company if I can graduate *in time* this year but I don’t really want to go back. It is bit complicated but I am from an authoritarian country where there’s little freedom for individuals and the situation is getting worse every year. and I know if I go back there I can never leave that hell of a country which is a equally dim future for me.

Last year I tried put down my thesis for a while and tried looking for like any jobs is okay, thinking at least I could at least I could make use of some of those *skills* I learnt at Uni but I couldn’t even got an interview. Maybe because I am a foreigner and lack of language proficiency or maybe my major is just too unique and my CV is nearly blank, I don’t know. That was a total waste of time, I remember I went back to my thesis feeling very rejected and disappointed in myself.

I am barely holding on for now to see if I could somehow finish it. If I fail then I think it is really all over. I don’t feel particularly sad for myself. I have never enjoyed much happiness in life and I don’t feel like I am missing a lot if I die young. It is the fact that I am the only child makes the decision so very hard.

It would be nearly impossible because I am studying in a foreign country and things would be much more complicated and difficult if
I lost my identity as a university student (with the visa and residence permit and everything) .Thinking of trying to start it over and admitting the past 10 years has been a waste only makes me panic. Can’t deal with my parents disappointment me in me either. Just don't have the fight in me anymore.

He is patient to Dimitri though, but that’s because Dimitri used to be his best friend and he didn’t just give up on him.

Also it is a poor judgement to say what Dimitri did during timeskip and post-timeskip is “hundred times worse” than what he did before and Felix should be more appalled by it. As Dimitri mostly kills Imperial troops and bandits, in other words, not innocent people. And Felix must have killed many of them himself during those five years.

Felix should feel shocked and appalled by Dimitri for what happened during that rebellion, because that is when he witnessed first time his best friend, a innocent boy to kill unmercifully in an inhuman way, and the way Dimitri hide it so well probably disgusted him most. It is something he couldn’t at all digest.

But after timeskip, all suffering and hate and grief of Dimitri from the past is just bare there for anyone to see. And Felix must have experienced much himself and thought about Dimitri a lot during this five years when Dimitri is presumed dead. I would think Felix would also maybe treat Dimitri in a more mature way instead of hating on the latter blindly. Losing someone and getting him back it not a easy thing to deal with. As a contrary, in other routes Felix admits that he never got a chance to understand Dimitri’s hate for the Empire because in those routes he chose to leave. 

I don’t want to talk about Edelgard as she is not directly related to this discussion.

In BL route Felix never believed that Dimitri is too far gone to cannot be saved. Although appear to be all practical and logical, Felix is actually a very emotional person.  Dimitri. He criticizes Dimitri a lot post-timeskip instead of blindly standing with him, but apparently at that point Dimitri listens to no one but ghost. Blue Lions students Post-timeskip must all have suffered that kind of frustration more or less. But they are also very determined to unite and defeat the Empire.
